supplements.title: Multifaceted bioactivity of brown seaweed-derived fucoidan from the Indian Coastline: A natural health product candidate.
supplements.summary: Fucoidan from Indian brown seaweed shows promise as a natural compound with antioxidant, antidiabetic, and breast cancer cell-killing properties.

supplements.title: Phytochemicals and callus suspension culture as cancer therapeutics.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds from lab-grown callus cultures show promise as less-toxic cancer treatments by triggering cancer cell death through multiple mechanisms.

supplements.title: Dietary Saponin-Mediated Health Promotion: Unraveling the Molecular Mechanism through the PI3K/Akt Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Dietary saponins from plants regulate a key cell pathway to improve metabolism, protect nerves, and reduce inflammation.

supplements.title: Sex determining region Y box protein 2 (SOX2) expression, alteration, regulation and its diagnostics, prognostics and therapeutics in lung cancer.
supplements.summary: SOX2 protein is highly expressed in lung cancer and drives tumor growth; cordycepin, a natural compound, suppresses this effect.

supplements.title: Hypoalbuminemia induces immunosuppression through disorder in macrophages and drives resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
supplements.summary: Low protein levels suppress immune cells and block cancer immunotherapy, but arginine supplementation restores treatment effectiveness by fixing macrophage function.

supplements.title: Curcumin and Its Protein Targets: Literature Review and Systems Biology Analysis.
supplements.summary: Curcumin targets multiple proteins involved in colorectal, breast, and lung cancers, though most targets lack experimental verification beyond computational predictions.

supplements.title: Impact of Lifestyle on the Association between Ambient Air Pollution and Insulin Resistance.
supplements.summary: Lifestyle factors like exercise and avoiding smoking may reduce air pollution's harmful effects on insulin resistance in adults.

supplements.title: Catha edulis and Datura stramonium mitigate oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and cell death in an SH-SY5Y model of Parkinson's disease.
supplements.summary: Plant extracts from Catha edulis and Datura stramonium reduce oxidative stress and cell death in Parkinson's disease models.

supplements.title: Panax ginseng-derived Exosome-like Nanoparticles Prevent LPS-induced Septic Shock by Modulating TLR4 Glycosylation in Macrophages.
supplements.summary: Ginseng nanoparticles reduce septic shock in mice by decreasing inflammatory responses in immune cells through modified protein structures.

supplements.title: Extracellular vesicles derived from senescent hepatocytes drive pan-cancer metastasis in aging.
supplements.summary: Aging liver cells release particles that promote cancer spread across multiple tumor types; blocking this process reduces metastasis in older mice.

supplements.title: Programmed cell death in cancer: targeting necroptosis to kill tumor cell.
supplements.summary: Researchers propose triggering necroptosis, a controlled cell death pathway, to kill tumor cells and overcome chemotherapy resistance.

supplements.title: Development of a Doxorubicin-Sitosterol Conjugate as a Radiosensitizer for Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers created a new drug combining doxorubicin and sitosterol that enhances radiation therapy while reducing drug dose and toxicity in cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Curcumin-Fullerene Nanoantioxidant Treats Ulcerative Colitis through Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Mechanisms.
supplements.summary: A nanoparticle formulation combining curcumin with fullerene improved treatment of ulcerative colitis by enhancing drug delivery and reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Effects of high-load, velocity-intentional variable resistance training combined with creatine supplementation on neuroplasticity, oxidative stress, inflammation, physical function, cognitive performance and quality of life in older adults: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
supplements.summary: High-load resistance training combined with creatine improved strength, brain function, and quality of life in older adults over 16 weeks.

supplements.title: Regulation of long non-coding RNAs by essential oils: Therapeutic implications in human diseases.
supplements.summary: Essential oils regulate cancer-related RNA molecules, offering potential new therapeutic treatments across multiple disease types.

off_label.title: Understanding single stranded DNA gaps: from formation to fate.
off_label.summary: Single-stranded DNA gaps could help predict cancer treatment response and guide personalized therapy strategies by identifying drug resistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Androgen Receptor-Induced Lactoferrin Accelerates Prostate Tumorigenesis Through Modulating Ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Lactoferrin, controlled by androgen receptor, protects prostate cancer cells from iron-induced death, offering a new treatment target.

off_label.title: NQO1-Mediated Anoikis Resistance and Immune Evasion Define a High-Risk Multi-Omic Subtype for Precision Management of T1 High-Grade Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a high-risk bladder cancer subtype driven by NQO1 protein, enabling better treatment selection between surgery and bladder preservation.

off_label.title: DROP-CARs: Engineering Reversible, Drug-Controlled CAR T Cell Activity with a Clinically Approved Small Molecule.
off_label.summary: Researchers engineered CAR T cells that can be turned on and off using an approved drug, reducing toxicity to healthy tissue in solid tumors.

off_label.title: Repurposing felodipine via hyaluronic acid-coated cetylosomes (HCCs) for parenteral active targeting of cancer: Box-Behnken statistical optimization, in vitro characterization, and in vivo studies.
off_label.summary: Researchers repurposed a blood pressure drug using coated nanoparticles to effectively target and kill breast cancer cells, especially when combined with chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Repurposing acetyldigitoxin as a potential EZH2 inhibitor for non-small cell lung cancer: a computational and experimental approach.
off_label.summary: Acetyldigitoxin, an FDA-approved drug, effectively kills lung cancer cells by blocking EZH2, a protein that promotes tumor growth and resistance.

off_label.title: The Importance of 5-hmC Expression Loss in Diagnosis of Mesothelioma and the Relationship Between TROP2 Expression and Histomorphological Parameters in Mesotheliomas.
off_label.summary: Loss of 5-hmC expression accurately distinguishes mesothelioma from benign conditions, and high TROP2 levels may predict treatment response.

off_label.title: Arachidonate lipoxygenase 5 metabolism axis promoting ferroptosis: a potential druggable target for doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy.
off_label.summary: Blocking the ALOX5 pathway may prevent heart damage caused by doxorubicin cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Extracellular vesicles derived from senescent hepatocytes drive pan-cancer metastasis in aging.
off_label.summary: Aging liver cells release particles that promote cancer spread across multiple tumor types; blocking this process reduces metastasis in older mice.

off_label.title: The anti-obesogenic metabolite, Lac-Phe, is elevated by metformin treatment in prostate cancer patients.
off_label.summary: Metformin treatment raises Lac-Phe metabolite levels in prostate cancer patients, potentially explaining weight management and metabolic benefits similar to exercise.

off_label.title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and the risk of late onset epilepsy: A real-world cohort study.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitor drugs may reduce epilepsy risk in older adults with type 2 diabetes.

off_label.title: Concept and connotation of the geroprotective and anti-aging effects of metformin: From AMPK Activation to SASP Suppression.
off_label.summary: Metformin, a common diabetes drug, may slow aging and reduce age-related diseases by activating protective cellular pathways in older adults.

off_label.title: Association Between Statin Use and Non-Melanoma Skin Cancer Risk: A Distributed Network Analysis of 11 Real-World Databases.
off_label.summary: Study of 11 databases found statins' link to non-melanoma skin cancer risk remains unclear due to conflicting evidence.

off_label.title: The cyclin-G associated kinase (GAK) is a novel mitotic kinase and therapeutic target in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
off_label.summary: Researchers identified GAK as a new drug target for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, especially in tumors with RB1 loss, and found existing drugs effectively inhibit it.

off_label.title: Entrectinib attenuates LPS-induced neuroinflammation by inhibiting JNK, p38, and AKT pathways and ameliorates cognitive impairment.
off_label.summary: Entrectinib, a lung cancer drug, reduces brain inflammation and improves memory by blocking specific inflammatory pathways in mice.

biomarkers.title: Early local immune activation following intra-operative radiotherapy in human breast tissue.
biomarkers.summary: Intraoperative breast radiation rapidly activates local immune responses, potentially improving combined radiotherapy-immunotherapy effectiveness in breast cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: Surgical management of concomitant lung cancer and cardiovascular diseases: a multidisciplinary perspective.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors should carefully coordinate cardiac and lung cancer treatments in elderly patients with both conditions, using staged approaches when possible.

biomarkers.title: Targeted degradation of c-Myc through the midnolin-proteasome pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists developed MbTACs, new molecules that degrade cancer-driving c-Myc protein through a novel pathway, showing promise against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Understanding single stranded DNA gaps: from formation to fate.

biomarkers.title: Standardized digital PCR assay validation using PCR-ValiPal, demonstrated in cross-platform quantification of bovine papilloma virus.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created PCR-ValiPal, a web tool that simplifies and standardizes the validation process for digital PCR assays used to detect viruses and genetic material.

biomarkers.title: SPARC: A programmable molecular diagnostic platform based on a signal-triggered, self-supplied crRNA and tiered PER-transcription-CRISPR cascade for early detection of hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists developed SPARC, a new molecular test that accurately detects microRNAs to enable early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis with improved sensitivity and specificity.

biomarkers.title: Ber-EP4 Expression and Staining Patterns in Cutaneous Basal Cell Carcinoma: A Clinicopathological Study From a Vietnamese Cohort.
biomarkers.summary: Ber-EP4 marker shows variable staining patterns in skin basal cell carcinoma, potentially complicating diagnosis despite high sensitivity.

biomarkers.title: Multimodal Multiorgan-on-a-Chip Platform for Probing Liver-Tumor Interactions and Advancing Prodrug Screening.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a microchip platform that mimics liver-tumor interactions to better test cancer prodrugs like capecitabine and tamoxifen.

biomarkers.title: Androgen Receptor-Induced Lactoferrin Accelerates Prostate Tumorigenesis Through Modulating Ferroptosis.
biomarkers.summary: Lactoferrin, controlled by androgen receptor, protects prostate cancer cells from iron-induced death, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: NQO1-Mediated Anoikis Resistance and Immune Evasion Define a High-Risk Multi-Omic Subtype for Precision Management of T1 High-Grade Bladder Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a high-risk bladder cancer subtype driven by NQO1 protein, enabling better treatment selection between surgery and bladder preservation.

biomarkers.title: Deposition Patterns of Carbon Black Nanoparticles in Pulmonary Lobes and Airway Generations: Implications for Lung Remodeling.
biomarkers.summary: Carbon black nanoparticle exposure causes greater lung density and airway thickening in upper lobes, with dose-dependent effects linked to particle deposition patterns.

biomarkers.title: Initial Insights Into an Institutional Secure Large Language Model for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Examination Requests: Retrospective Study.
biomarkers.summary: A secure AI tool helped doctors complete MRI scan requests more thoroughly by retrieving patient information from medical records.

biomarkers.title: Multifaceted bioactivity of brown seaweed-derived fucoidan from the Indian Coastline: A natural health product candidate.
biomarkers.summary: Fucoidan from Indian brown seaweed shows promise as a natural compound with antioxidant, antidiabetic, and breast cancer cell-killing properties.

biomarkers.title: Retreatment with First-Generation Selective RET Inhibitors in RET-Rearranged NSCLC Pretreated with Selpercatinib or Pralsetinib - Results from the RET-MAP Registry.
biomarkers.summary: RET-rearranged lung cancer patients who relapsed after initial RET inhibitor treatment benefited from retreatment with the same drug class.

biomarkers.title: Venetoclax-Based Regimens in Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Venetoclax combined with chemotherapy shows promise in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, achieving high response rates but low complete remissions and significant side effects.

trials.summary: Intraoperative breast radiation rapidly activates local immune responses, potentially improving combined radiotherapy-immunotherapy effectiveness in breast cancer patients.

trials.title: Surgical management of concomitant lung cancer and cardiovascular diseases: a multidisciplinary perspective.
trials.summary: Doctors should carefully coordinate cardiac and lung cancer treatments in elderly patients with both conditions, using staged approaches when possible.

trials.title: Retreatment with First-Generation Selective RET Inhibitors in RET-Rearranged NSCLC Pretreated with Selpercatinib or Pralsetinib - Results from the RET-MAP Registry.
trials.summary: RET-rearranged lung cancer patients who relapsed after initial RET inhibitor treatment benefited from retreatment with the same drug class.

trials.title: Venetoclax-Based Regimens in Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: Venetoclax combined with chemotherapy shows promise in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, achieving high response rates but low complete remissions and significant side effects.

trials.title: ADC target profiling in NSCLC: Generalizable AI separates TROP-2 and cMET phenotypes.
trials.summary: AI technology accurately identifies which lung cancer patients would benefit from TROP-2 or cMET-targeting drug treatments.

trials.title: A first-in-human phase 1 clinical trial evaluating clinical activity and proof-of-mechanism of tobemstomig, a PD1-LAG3 bispecific antibody, in patients with CPI-experienced melanoma.
trials.summary: A new dual-action antibody drug shows promise in melanoma patients who didn't respond to prior immunotherapy treatments.

trials.title: Study of Procedural Efficiency in EBUS with Dual versus Single NEEDLEs: Evaluating the Value of a Second Needle in EBUS as it Pertains to Economic and Environmental Impact.
trials.summary: Using two needles during lung lymph node biopsies speeds up individual needle passes without changing total procedure time or diagnostic quality.

trials.title: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial fine-needle aspiration of mediastinal lymph nodes: a clinical appraisal of diagnostic accuracy and molecular utility.
trials.summary: A minimally invasive needle technique effectively diagnoses lung cancer and identifies enlarged lymph nodes in the chest.

trials.title: Targeting conserved domains of hypoxia-inducible factors for cancer therapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed dual HIF inhibitors that block tumor growth, improve immunotherapy response, and show safety across multiple cancer types.

trials.title: Oocyte-inspired universal whole-cell vaccines against tumor heterogeneity.
trials.summary: Researchers created whole-cell cancer vaccines with protective shells that preserve tumor antigens, offering personalized treatment against diverse tumor types.

trials.title: Toward the simultaneous detection of multiple diseases with a highly cost-effective cell-free DNA methylome test.
trials.summary: MethylScan, a cost-effective blood test, simultaneously detects multiple cancers using DNA methylation patterns with 94% accuracy.

trials.title: Deep Learning Driven Evaluation of MR-guided Focused Ultrasound Ablation.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a deep learning system using MRI scans to better predict breast cancer treatment success during focused ultrasound therapy.

trials.title: Adaptive Regulation of dNTP Homeostasis Confers Osimertinib Resistance in EGFR-Mutant Non-small Cell Lung Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Lung cancer cells resist osimertinib by activating a backup pathway that maintains DNA building blocks; blocking this pathway restores drug sensitivity.

trials.title: DPY30 is an epigenetic decoupler linking replication stress to immunoediting in pancreatic cancer.
trials.summary: Blocking DPY30 in pancreatic cancer destabilizes DNA replication, triggering immune cell infiltration and improving immunotherapy response.

trials.title: DROP-CARs: Engineering Reversible, Drug-Controlled CAR T Cell Activity with a Clinically Approved Small Molecule.
trials.summary: Researchers engineered CAR T cells that can be turned on and off using an approved drug, reducing toxicity to healthy tissue in solid tumors.

mind_body.title: Cultural Adaptation and Feasibility of an Inpatient Yoga Intervention for Patients Undergoing Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in Tanzania, India, and the United States: A Study Protocol.
mind_body.summary: Researchers are testing a culturally adapted yoga program to help blood cancer transplant patients manage symptoms during hospitalization across Tanzania, India, and the United States.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of qigong on subjective cognitive function in cancer survivors: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Qigong may help improve thinking and memory problems in cancer survivors, according to a review of existing studies.

mind_body.title: Cortical thickness, surface area, and multisite pain: distinct patterns by sex in adolescence.
mind_body.summary: Researchers found sex-based differences in how adolescents' brain structure relates to experiencing pain at multiple body sites.

mind_body.title: The Central Qi theory in traditional Chinese medicine: Gut microbiota modulation as a strategic target for hepatocellular carcinoma therapy.
mind_body.summary: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine may improve quality of life and treatment tolerance in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma patients by modulating gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based stress reduction in managing fatigue, anxiety, and depression among non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy: A randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based stress reduction helped reduce fatigue, anxiety, and depression in lung cancer patients undergoing surgery and chemotherapy.

mind_body.title: Prevalence and severity of imposter phenomenon in consultant radiographers.
mind_body.summary: Study finds self-doubt feelings are common among consultant radiographers despite their proven competence and expertise.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Yoga and Relaxation Techniques on Anxiety, Stress Levels, and Quality of Life in Parents of Children Diagnosed with Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Yoga and relaxation techniques significantly improve anxiety, stress, and quality of life in parents caring for children with cancer.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture Enhances Effectiveness of Omeprazole in Indomethacin-Induced Gastric Injury Mice via Nrf2 Activation and Vagus Nerve Conduction.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with omeprazole more effectively heals drug-induced stomach damage in mice than omeprazole alone.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.
